explanation: The theorem identifies two library-local definitions: `UnramifiedWhittaker.unipotent` (Definitions/Def_UnramifiedWhittaker_HeckeRecursion.lean, line 23) and `AutomorphicForm.unipotentGL2` (Definitions/Def_AutomorphicForm_ConstantTerm.lean, line 17). Both are defined in this library, not in Mathlib, so the statement compares two project-specific constructions of the upper unitriangular matrix !![1, x; 0, 1] as an element of GL (Fin 2) F. Searching Mathlib for `unipotentGL2`, `UnramifiedWhittaker`, and unipotent matrix definitions in GL(2) turned up nothing corresponding; Mathlib has no lemma stating an equality between these (nonexistent) definitions. The proof is just `Units.ext` plus unfolding the library-definition `unipotent` and the simp lemma `unipotentGL2_coe`, i.e. content entirely in the library's own definitions.
